_jobApplication.jobTitle: Principal GTM Specialist Solution Architect AI/ML, GenAI, EMEA Data and AI Solutions Architecture
_jobApplication.jobDescription: AWS Specialist Solutions Architects (SSAs) are technologists with deep domain-specific expertise, able to address advanced concepts and feature designs. AI/ML/GenAI Specialist Solutions Architects combine technical skills in AI/ML/GenAI business acumen, and technical sales skills. The Principal SSA leads large-scale, strategic AI/ML initiatives spanning multiple business units and areas with complete independence. They influence AI/ML strategy at the highest organizational levels, engaging with C-suite executives. Responsibilities: leverage deep understanding of EMEA AI/ML requirements to influence AWS service teams and product roadmaps; lead technical direction for GenAIML/Agentic themes from data pipelines to AI workflows; establish gold standard deliverables; scale technical community mechanisms across EMEA; represent AWS through high-profile speaking engagements and thought leadership; serve as escalation point for strategic accounts. Basic Quals: 12+ years design/implementation/consulting of distributed apps; 7+ years management of technical, customer facing resources; 7+ years production AI/ML/GenAI/Agentic systems (LLMs/multi-modal FMs, fine-tuning, distributed inference, RAG, FM evaluation, Vector DBs, Agentic workflows, prompt/context engineering, MLOps); C-level engagement. Preferred: advanced degree in ML/AI/CS; 12+ years SA experience; influence at C-level; track record across multiple industries and geographies; strong understanding of EMEA regulatory landscape.
_jobApplication.notes: Tailored for Principal GTM Specialist SA AI/ML, GenAI, EMEA. Surface: AWS-native AI work (Robogen on AWS, AWS Public Sector Blog, AWS Cloud Credits), production GenAI/agentic systems (LumApps, Beekeeper LLM pipeline + AI Onboarding + CrewAI/Strands/Langfuse), C-level reporting, EMEA presence (Zurich), thought leadership (talks + Substack on agentic AI), MLOps/evaluation/governance.
